lines: Mind the bottles. I would rather greet you than clean up glass.
Hello. Give me a moment to put this cork in.
You look well enough to stand, which is a good start.
Come in, but leave a clear path to the brewing stand.
Good to see you. Are you hurt or only visiting?
Watch your sleeve near that flame.
There you are. I was beginning to think the rain kept you away.
Welcome. The room smells worse than the remedies taste.
Careful by the shelf. I sorted those for a reason.
Hello. Sit if your legs are less steady than your voice.
You arrived between brews. That is fortunate.
Come closer if you need help, but not too close to the fire.
Good morning. I have clean water and a little time.
If you are here for a potion, tell me what happened first.
Welcome back. You look less troubled than last time.
Mind the cat. It believes this is its workplace.
Hello. I am listening, even if the stand is bubbling.
Settle in. I only have one dangerous bottle open today.
You caught me cleaning glass, which never seems to end.
Good to see a familiar face on a quiet day.
